products.name: MEDIUM CAMILLE 16 SOFT BAG IN SMOOTH CALFSKIN
products.details: 14.2 x 11.6 x 2.8 IN (36 x 29.5 x 7 CM)CALFSKINlambskin liningCross-body and shoulder carryTURN LOCK CLOSUREONE MAIN COMPARTMENTone inner zipped pocketTwo removable straps : one for hand or shoulder carry with a 9,8 IN (25 CM) drop & one adjustable for cross-body carry with a minimum drop 16,5 IN (42 CM) and maximum drop 19 IN (48 CM)Reference : 119563FX9.38NO
products.description:
The CAMILLE bag, the newest addition to the 16 soft line, a hobo shape with a functional design embodies the quintessence of the CELINE spirit.

Its refined calfskin leather combines suppleness with a soft touch and shiny finish. The reversed construction with piping, distinctive of CELINE’s leathergood craftsmanship, further accentuates its round hand.Its structured cut is borrowed from the 16 soft tote bag and gives it a sophisticated and singular appearance. The leather flap folds in line with the house’s gold finish iconic turnlock closure, shaped like a discreet jewel.

The CAMILLE 16 soft versatility is expressed through a short handle, allowing an elegant and refined shoulder carry whereas a longer adjustable handle allows a more casual and effortless crossbody carry. The two removable straps can be fixed and worn together or separately using CELINE engraved hooks.

For its first season, The CELINE 16 soft comes in a medium size, in black, tan and sand leather. A smaller version is available in black, tan and rice leather, as well as natural python.

products.name: CLASSIQUE TRIOMPHE BAG in shiny calfskin
products.details: 9 x 6 x 2 IN (22 x 15.5 x 6 CM)CalfskinLambskin LiningSILVER FINISHINGCross-body and shoulder carryTriomphe metallic closurethree inner compartmentsone inner zipped pocket one inner flat pocketadjustable strap with a minimum drop 18 IN (44 CM) and maximum drop 20 IN (51 CM)Reference : 187363BF4.38SI
products.description:
The Triomphe bag embodies the very essence of the CELINE look.
Named Triomphe as a tribute to Céline Vipiana, the Classique has the makings of a unique bag: a sophisticated construction, a signature emblem clasp and prestigious leathers.
Composed of 89 pieces, the Triomphe bag requires exceptional leather-making craftmanship and delicate blending for its construction.
The gold-finished hardware, a signature of the CELINE style, signals its personality. The clasp - a reinterpretation of the Maison’s iconic 1970s logo - integrates a mechanism developed like a piece of jewellery, built symmetrically in two parts.
It is crafted with the most iconic CELINE leathers – satin calfskin and natural tan calfskin – balancing the bag’s softness and structure.
The Classique is the most emblematic model in the Triomphe family, designed with a timeless aesthetic.
